# iosxr_logging_events_link_status (Data Source)

This data source can read the Logging Events Link Status configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxr_logging_events_link_status" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `disable` (Boolean) Disable state UP/DOWN notifications for all interfaces
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `software_interfaces` (Boolean) Enable state UP/DOWN notification for software interfaces
